endpoint projects.list {
  route: GET "/projects"
  output: [Project]
}

endpoint projects.get {
  route: GET "/projects/[id]"
  output: Project
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint projects.create {
  route: POST "/projects"
  input: { name: string(max 80), summary: string(max 400) }
  output: Project
  errors: invalid_input
}

endpoint projects.update {
  route: PATCH "/projects/[id]"
  input: { name: string(max 80), summary: string(max 400) } (all optional)
  output: Project
  errors: not_found, invalid_input
}

endpoint projects.delete {
  route: DELETE "/projects/[id]"
  errors: not_found, in_use
}

endpoint projects.tasks {
  route: GET "/projects/[id]/tasks"
  output: [Task]
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint tasks.list {
  route: GET "/tasks"
  output: [Task]
}

endpoint tasks.get {
  route: GET "/tasks/[id]"
  output: Task
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint tasks.create {
  route: POST "/tasks"
  input: { title: string(max 120), status: Status, due: date, project_id: Project.id }
  output: Task
  errors: invalid_input
}

endpoint tasks.update {
  route: PATCH "/tasks/[id]"
  input: { title: string(max 120), status: Status, due: date, project_id: Project.id } (all optional)
  output: Task
  errors: not_found, invalid_input
}

endpoint tasks.delete {
  route: DELETE "/tasks/[id]"
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint complete {
  route: POST "/complete"
  input: { task: Task }
  output: Task
  errors: invalid_input, already_done
  steps: finish_task
}
